Wait, 0.125 is the area of the full half-square, so triangles formed by (0,0),(1,0),(0.5,1) have area 0.25. Smaller triangles exist. Consider (0.5,0),(0.5,0.5),(0.25,0). The area is 0.5 * 0.25 * 0.5 = 0.0625. With the added points at (0.5,0.25) and (0.5,0.75), the smallest triangle is (0.5,0.25),(0.5,0.5),(0,0.333333), which has area = 0.5 * 0.5 * (0.5 - 0.333333) = 0.25 * 0.166667 = 0.041667.
